name: IINA
description: IINA configures Sparkle with an HTTPS appcast and a pinned SUPublicEDKey, selecting stable or beta feeds through its updater delegate. Runtime signature enforcement is delegated to Sparkle, and this newly retrieved snapshot does not reverify the historical release.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; Sparkle's dependency-level verifier and historical release artifact signing were not independently reverified.
